name: Absolution
summary: Absolution is a full 3D first-person adventure game where story, graphics, animation, sound and original music intertwine to put a spell on you as you immerse yourself in the non-linear gameplay, with captivating environments and interesting characters. The characters in the game do indeed want absolution, from an unfavourable past where tinkering with the unknown has given birth to the "Entropy", an uncontrollable vortex. As the main character asks for your help, you are confronted with a giant theme park guitar that has been ripped apart, while the Entropy pulsates dangerously in the background. Your only transport between the islands is an old hoverflyer that barely holds together, but it swiftly takes you on the adventure in discovering seven islands and the mysteries they pose. Along the journey, you will meet live action characters that are haunted by their own past, and as you slowly learn their oddities, they may indeed choose to help you.
